reasons: The excerpt explicitly says, "What you want to be focusing on nine times out of 10 is revenue per visitor or revenue per session."
The candidate retains the source's nine-out-of-ten qualifier and identifies the immediately preceding contrast with fixation on conversion rate.
The claim accurately reflects the source's definition of CRO as website adjustments and improvements intended to increase a chosen metric, with average order value and conversion rate as examples.
However, the title calls CRO "iterative," while the supplied excerpt says only that it involves "various adjustments and improvements" and does not establish repeated testing or iteration.
The excerpt explicitly states, "Generally, we will track a mix of two."
The candidate appropriately does not assert that the preceding examples—average order value and conversion rate—are definitively the two tracked metrics.
The quoted passage supports that Ezra says Conversion Wise performs surveys, research, and data analysis and then may adjust messaging or layout based on its customer and marketplace understanding.

The candidate turns Ezra's description and endorsement of one agency's stated practice into a general imperative for the reader. The excerpt does not expressly prescribe this as a universal optimization procedure.
Its trigger, "When it comes to optimization of brands," is derived from Ezra's personal account rather than stated as a condition for the proposed action.

Ezra explicitly says that as a business owner overseeing many functions, "you can only be so effective at any one discipline" and describes outsourcing customer support and video editing before becoming "the navigator of the ship, not the driver of the car."
The candidate preserves that this is a scaling/delegation principle illustrated through Ezra's own experience, rather than claiming a specified delegation sequence.
Ali promises to explain hypothesis formation, data analysis, and test creation, but none of those procedures is delivered in the supplied excerpt.
The candidate correctly identifies the material as an unresolved promise caused by the excerpt ending before the promised framework.
The supplied text ends with the incomplete phrase, "Revenue per visitor or revenue per," so the continuation is not present in this excerpt.
The candidate appropriately treats the missing continuation as unspecified rather than asserting a definite completion.
The source explicitly observes that brands are "fixated over conversion rates."
The surrounding sentence contrasts that fixation with the stated preference for revenue per visitor or revenue per session nine times out of ten, supporting the warning framing.
Ali explicitly says, "we never pitch. We don't sell anything."
The candidate presents this as the speaker's stated principle and does not add a method or performance outcome absent from the excerpt.
Ezra directly states, "I went through six different uh conversion agencies over four years."
The candidate correctly treats this as Ezra's example and does not invent agency names, selection criteria, or reasons for leaving.
Ezra says Conversion Wise can design direct-response landing pages and "can run split tests for you."
The candidate does not claim that the landing pages or tests produced measured performance results, which the excerpt does not provide.
Ali asks attendees to use the chat to confirm that they can see his screen and states that this is important before he starts.
The action, timing, and purpose are all directly supported by the quoted passage.
Ali says the workshop will include before-and-after designs, reasons for the tests, results, "over $3 million worth of winning tests for Ezra's brands," and additional bonuses.
The candidate properly attributes these as what Ali says the workshop will showcase, rather than claiming the case studies are actually presented within this excerpt.
Immediately after naming revenue per visitor or revenue per session as the preferred focus nine times out of ten, Ali says, "So write that down."
The candidate's reference to the focus metric is supported by that immediate context.
